rows.itemTitle: FRANCHISOR ASSISTANCE ADVERTISING COMPUTER SYSTEMS AND TRAINING
rows.summary: Between 2014 and 2018, Item 11 raised the disclosed monthly microsite fee from $220 to $260 and the computer-system cost estimate from $3,500-$8,000 to $7,500-$10,000, added a written-waiver requirement and annual review of computer specifications, shifted Initial Franchise Training from 36 classroom/136 on-the-job hours to 130/48 hours, changed Year 1-2 Regular Training to 164/121 hours while cutting year-5-and-later hours to 76, moved the local-advertising quarterly trigger from Agreement Date to Opening Date with a within-30-days spending deadline, broadened the domain-name prohibition, and removed the disclosed 50-franchisee marketing-fund threshold.
